Pure configuration planning: no files, weights, feature tensors, fitting or job
submission. The scheduler must bind and admit new runtime resources before use.
"""
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path

from .training import ARMS, prepare_runtime


_EXECUTION_KEYS = (
    "resume", "resume_samples", "resume_from_output", "attempt", "handoff_request",
    "handoff_ack", "required_gpu_uuid", "recovery_reason", "replaces_run",
    "source_last_samples", "rollback_samples", "infrastructure_continuation",
    "seed0_run", "diagnostic_feature_root", "checkpoint", "features",
    "persist_features", "recipe_preparation_only", "node", "local_node",
    "gpu_uuid", "execution", "local_storage", "local_output_root",
    "local_storage_peak_bytes", "local_concurrent_bytes", "storage_peak_bytes",
    "share_storage_peak_bytes", "root_joint_future_bytes", "lustre_other_future_bytes",
    "output_filesystem", "model_budget_root", "storage_forecast_basis",
    "minimum_free_gpu_mib", "cleanup_seconds", "speed_calibration",
    "calibration_training", "benchmark_updates", "speed_board",
)


def _screening(parent):
    if (parent.get("condition") != "D" or parent.get("arm") not in ARMS
            or parent["arm"].startswith("9M-") or parent.get("seed") != 0
            or parent.get("samples") != 3_000_000):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation uses a registered seed0 3M D condition")
    return deepcopy(parent)


def _cold(parent, arm, *, output_root, run_prefix, retain_h0):
    c = deepcopy(parent)
    for key in _EXECUTION_KEYS:
        c.pop(key, None)
    c.update(arm=arm, run=run_prefix + arm.replace("-", "_") + "_seed0",
        seed=0, samples=9_000_000, round=0, stage=4,
        output=str(Path(output_root) / arm / "training"),
        evaluation_samples=[9_000_000], statistics_backend="slurm_cpu",
        persist_final_features=retain_h0, resource_admission_pending=True,
        confirmation_source_run=parent["run"])
    # A cold run measures its own window; no fitted screening state survives.
    c["clip_calibration"] = dict(calibration_samples=150000,
        window_start_samples=60000, initial_clip=281.7, quantile=.99,
        sample_axis="optimizer_step_start")
    binding = c["d_recipe"].setdefault("scientific_binding", {})
    for key in ("arm", "seed", "samples"):
        binding.pop(key, None)
    return prepare_runtime(c)


def plan_confirmation(best, baseline, selected=None, *, output_root, run_prefix):
    """Return R0 always, and final only when it differs; no seed1 confirmation.

    Selected is the final scientific configuration frozen after all gates,
    including any adopted mask or 3D decision. No recipe selection happens here.
    Existing TRAIN parameters and all model settings stay unchanged.
    Output resources and target hardware are deliberately unbound in this plan.
    """
    if best.get("status") != "FROZEN" or best.get("recipe_frozen") is not True:
        raise ValueError("All D decisions and the final recipe freeze precede confirmation")
    baseline = _screening(baseline)
    if (baseline["arm"] != "D-R0" or baseline.get("components")
            or not baseline["d_recipe"].get("include_3d", True)
            or baseline["d_recipe"].get("graph_mask_enabled", False)):
        raise ValueError("The confirmation baseline is the original D-R0 condition")
    if best.get("arm") == "D-R0":
        selected = baseline
    elif selected is None:
        raise ValueError("The frozen selected scientific configuration is required")
    else:
        selected = _screening(selected)
    if (selected["arm"] != best.get("arm")
            or selected["d_recipe"]["library"] != best.get("library")):
        raise ValueError("Selected condition differs from the frozen D recipe")
    if "components" in best and set(selected.get("components", ())) != set(best["components"]):
        raise ValueError("Selected components differ from the frozen D recipe")
    same = best["arm"] == "D-R0"
    configurations = [_cold(baseline, "9M-D-R0", output_root=output_root,
        run_prefix=run_prefix, retain_h0=same)]
    if not same:
        configurations.append(_cold(selected, "9M-D-final", output_root=output_root,
            run_prefix=run_prefix, retain_h0=True))
    return dict(schema="D_COLD_CONFIRMATION_PLAN_V1",
        status="SCIENTIFIC_CONFIGURATIONS_REQUIRE_RUNTIME_RESOURCE_ADMISSION",
        frozen_arm=best["arm"], frozen_library=best["library"],
        selected_readout_arm="9M-D-R0" if same else "9M-D-final",
        configurations=configurations, jobs_submitted=False)

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from tools.d_recipe.confirmation_plan import plan_confirmation
from tools.d_recipe.train import final_readout


def screening(arm="D-R0"):
    return dict(condition="D", arm=arm, run=arm + "_seed0", seed=0, samples=3_000_000,
        batch_size=32, microbatch_size=32, lr=3e-4, weight_decay=.01,
        betas=[.9, .95], warmup_fraction=.02, distance_bias="C1-0", schedule="cosine",
        components=[] if arm == "D-R0" else ["A1", "B3", "B4"],
        p_recipe={}, clip_calibration=dict(calibration_samples=150000,
            window_start_samples=60000, initial_clip=281.7, quantile=.99),
        output="/screen/" + arm, readout_store="/native_store.json",
        reference_manifest="/random_reference.json", source="PM7",
        d_recipe=dict(enabled=True, library="L1" if arm == "D-L1" else "D20",
            include_3d=True, graph_mask_enabled=False,
            block_weights=dict(graph_2d=.6, molecule_3d=.3, atom_sasa=.1),
            label_parameters="/frozen_TRAIN_parameters.json"))


def frozen(arm="D-R0"):
    return dict(status="FROZEN", recipe_frozen=True, arm=arm,
        library="L1" if arm == "D-L1" else "D20",
        components=[] if arm == "D-R0" else ["A1", "B3", "B4"])


def plan(best=None, baseline=None, selected=None):
    return plan_confirmation(best or frozen(), baseline or screening(), selected,
        output_root="/confirmation", run_prefix="d_")


class ConfirmationPlanTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unfinished_recipe_never_prepares_confirmation(self):
        for changes in (dict(status="RUNNING"), dict(recipe_frozen=False)):
            best = frozen()
            best.update(changes)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "freeze"):
                plan(best)

    def test_native_selection_requests_only_one_cold_run_and_retains_its_h0(self):
        result = plan()
        self.assertEqual([c["arm"] for c in result["configurations"]], ["9M-D-R0"])
        c = result["configurations"][0]
        self.assertEqual((c["seed"], c["samples"]), (0, 9_000_000))
        self.assertEqual(c["checkpoint_samples"], list(range(1_000_000, 9_000_001, 1_000_000)))
        self.assertEqual(c["evaluation_samples"], [9_000_000])
        self.assertTrue(c["persist_final_features"])
        self.assertFalse(result["jobs_submitted"])

    def test_transferred_selection_keeps_original_baseline_and_only_selected_h0(self):
        original, selected, best = screening(), screening("D-L1"), frozen("D-L1")
        before = deepcopy((original, selected, best))
        result = plan(best, original, selected)
        a, b = result["configurations"]
        self.assertEqual((a["arm"], b["arm"]), ("9M-D-R0", "9M-D-final"))
        self.assertEqual((a["d_recipe"]["library"], b["d_recipe"]["library"]), ("D20", "L1"))
        self.assertFalse(a["persist_final_features"])
        self.assertTrue(b["persist_final_features"])
        self.assertEqual(b["d_recipe"]["label_parameters"], "/frozen_TRAIN_parameters.json")
        self.assertEqual(b["d_recipe"]["scientific_binding"]["samples"], 9_000_000)
        self.assertEqual((original, selected, best), before)

    def test_old_resume_cache_runtime_and_fitted_clip_state_do_not_survive(self):
        selected = screening("D-L1")
        selected.update(resume="/old.pt", resume_samples=1000000,
            resume_from_output="/old", handoff_ack="/ack", diagnostic_feature_root="/3M/cache",
            checkpoint="/3M.pt", features="/old_features", infrastructure_continuation={},
            storage_peak_bytes=1, share_storage_peak_bytes=2, node="old_node", gpu_uuid="old_gpu",
            local_output_root="/old_node/cache", local_storage_peak_bytes=3, local_concurrent_bytes=4)
        selected["clip_calibration"].update(threshold=123., fitted=True, observed_updates=2813)
        c = plan(frozen("D-L1"), selected=selected)["configurations"][1]
        for key in ("resume", "resume_samples", "resume_from_output", "handoff_ack",
                "diagnostic_feature_root", "checkpoint", "features", "infrastructure_continuation",
                "storage_peak_bytes", "share_storage_peak_bytes", "node", "gpu_uuid",
                "local_output_root", "local_storage_peak_bytes", "local_concurrent_bytes"):
            self.assertNotIn(key, c)
        self.assertTrue(c["resource_admission_pending"])
        self.assertNotIn("fitted", c["clip_calibration"])
        self.assertNotIn("threshold", c["clip_calibration"])
        self.assertEqual(c["clip_calibration"]["window_start_samples"], 60000)

    def test_final_readout_uses_new_endpoint_and_retention_switch(self):
        c = plan(frozen("D-L1"), selected=screening("D-L1"))["configurations"][1]
        readout = final_readout(c, lambda config, samples: "/new/samples_" + str(samples) + ".pt")
        self.assertEqual(readout["checkpoint"], "/new/samples_9000000.pt")
        self.assertEqual(readout["features"], "/confirmation/9M-D-final/training/features_9000000")
        self.assertTrue(readout["persist_features"])
        self.assertNotIn("diagnostic_feature_root", readout)

    def test_only_registered_seed0_screening_sources_can_prepare_confirmation(self):
        for changes in (dict(seed=1), dict(samples=9_000_000), dict(arm="9M-D-final")):
            selected = screening("D-L1")
            selected.update(changes)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "seed0 3M"):
                plan(frozen("D-L1"), selected=selected)

    def test_frozen_library_or_components_mismatch_is_not_silently_changed(self):
        for changes in (dict(library="L2"), dict(components=[])):
            best = frozen("D-L1")
            best.update(changes)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "frozen D recipe"):
                plan(best, selected=screening("D-L1"))

    def test_adopted_mask_seed_is_preserved_for_a_fresh_confirmation(self):
        selected = screening("D-K1")
        selected["d_recipe"].update(library="L1", adopted_wide=True,
            graph_mask_enabled=True, mask_seed=20261119)
        best = frozen("D-K1")
        best["library"] = "L1"
        c = plan(best, selected=selected)["configurations"][1]
        self.assertTrue(c["d_recipe"]["graph_mask_enabled"])
        self.assertEqual(c["d_recipe"]["mask_seed"], 20261119)
        self.assertTrue(c["d_recipe"]["include_3d"])

    def test_frozen_wide_and_geometry_decisions_can_be_composed_only_in_final(self):
        selected = screening("D-L1")
        selected["d_recipe"]["include_3d"] = False
        a, b = plan(frozen("D-L1"), selected=selected)["configurations"]
        self.assertTrue(a["d_recipe"]["include_3d"])
        self.assertFalse(b["d_recipe"]["include_3d"])
        self.assertEqual(b["d_recipe"]["block_weights"], selected["d_recipe"]["block_weights"])

    def test_native_baseline_cannot_be_replaced_by_a_transferred_condition(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "original D-R0"):
            plan(baseline=screening("D-R1"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
